group.passage:
Besides suspended meals and coin donation boxes, there’s yet another way to reach out to the disadvantaged, with the added benefit of doing good for the environment.
In an obscure corner of a famous night market in Taipei stands a vending machine of various types of baked goods, such as toast, bread, and doughnut. What sets this machine apart from others is that the bread is given away for free. Equipped with facial recognition capability, the machine will dispense bread to the same person twice a day at most. People in need can work the touch screen and select the bread of their liking from nearby shelves, which were built with rows of transparent plastic compartments from which people can view the varied contents of each serving of bread.
In a bid to tackle food waste and to help the less fortunate, the local borough chief Mr. Fang convinced bakeries in the greater Taipei area to give away the bread that remains unsold and will usually end up in trash bin at the end of each day. Volunteers will first unwrap the donated bread to ensure it’s of decent or acceptable quality, before packaging the bread into separate plastic bags to be distributed again. The bread stays frozen in the vending machine and is good to eat when left in room temperature for a couple of hours. On a weekly basis, roughly two tons of bread pass through their hands.
According to Mr. Fang, the vending machine in question is a fresh spin on how to deal with an age-old issue. It reduces food waste, helps the poor, and saves plenty of cost on human labor, since no manpower is needed to run or supervise the machine. Hopefully, there will be more machines of such kind in the future.

figures.label: the following pictures（第4題選項 (A)–(D)）
figures.caption: 第4題選項 (A)–(D)：四幅販賣機插圖
figures.description: 黑白線條插圖，四個選項各為一種販賣機：(A) 外型像冰箱的雙層櫃式機器，上層的門向左打開（門上有窗格），櫃內右側是一列列堆疊的圓形麵包（貝果或甜甜圈），中間下方有小螢幕和按鍵，下層是兩扇對開的櫃門，底部裝有輪子；(B) 兩座並排、立在短腳上的高層架，各有五層透明隔間，每一格裡都放著一袋袋不同的麵包（可看到包裝袋口的綁結），層架右邊另立一臺較高的直立式機器，正面是大面積的深色螢幕面板，上方有幾個小方形按鍵；(C) 傳統的麵包販賣機，上半部是透明櫥窗，分上下兩排陳列五種麵包，每格上方貼有中文品名標籤（可辨識「牛角麵包」「甜甜圈」，其餘為三角形蛋糕、表面有格紋的菠蘿麵包、橢圓形麵包的品名），下半部有投幣／付款口與按鈕，以及標示「取物口」的長方形出貨口；(D) 正面是整片大型觸控螢幕的販賣機，螢幕上排列幾種麵包的圖片（格紋麵包、牛角麵包、甜甜圈、橢圓形麵包），一名長髮女子站在機器右側，右手點選螢幕上的牛角麵包圖示，左手拿著手機（或卡片），機器下方有出貨口；沒有陳列麵包的貨架。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: How the poor can give back to the community.
options.B: Ways that the government can improve the economy.
options.C: What charitable organizations must do in the future.
options.D: A novel idea that can solve more than one problem.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true about the vending machine described in the passage?

options.A: It gives away the bread that is still edible.
options.B: Volunteers will stand by the machine in the day.
options.C: It does not charge people for what they get.
options.D: It relies on people’s donation of bread.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage?

options.A: The person who promotes the idea of the vending machine.
options.B: How the vending machine is different from other machines.
options.C: Public opinion on Mr. Fang’s idea of the vending machine.
options.D: The process through which the bread ends up in the vending machine.

questions.stem: Which of the following pictures is most likely to be the vending machine described in the passage?

options.A: ［圖］一臺門向外打開的雙層櫃式機器：上層的門向左敞開（門上有窗格），櫃內右側是一列列堆疊的圓形麵包（貝果或甜甜圈），中間下方有小螢幕和按鍵；下層是兩扇對開的櫃門，底部裝有輪子。
options.B: ［圖］兩座並排的高層架，各有五層透明隔間，每一格裡都放著一袋袋不同的麵包；層架右邊另立一臺直立式機器，正面是大面積的螢幕面板，上方有幾個小按鍵。
options.C: ［圖］一臺傳統的麵包販賣機：上半部是透明櫥窗，分上下兩排陳列五種麵包（可辨識的中文品名標籤有「牛角麵包」「甜甜圈」，另有一塊三角形蛋糕、一個表面有格紋的菠蘿麵包和一個橢圓形麵包），下方有投幣／付款口、按鈕，以及標示「取物口」的出貨口。
options.D: ［圖］一臺正面是整片大型觸控螢幕的販賣機，螢幕上顯示多種麵包的圖片；一名女子一手點選螢幕上的麵包圖示、另一手拿著手機（或卡片），機器下方有出貨口；畫面中沒有陳列麵包的貨架。
